1850.s: At a famous scrimmage we had here with Fraser at Parker's Ferry, the cappin mounted a British officer, and told him to deliver, and wanted to make him prisoner, but the red coat was either mighty drunk or mighty sassy, and when there was no sense in it, for he couldn't git off, he run his horse close agin the cappin's, and flashed his pistol in his face.
